content: The specifications of needles, as outlined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), emphasize the importance of both needle gauge and length for insulin administration. The thickness of the needle, determined by its gauge, can influence the level of pain experienced during injection as well as the efficiency of insulin absorption. Needles with shorter lengths are frequently recommended to reduce the likelihood of discomfort and to minimize the risk of injecting insulin into deeper tissues, which could compromise its effectiveness.
